intro.name: Jan Tokic
intro.title: Software Engineer
intro.bio: I'm a software engineer from Austria, based in Munich. I build fast, reliable systems that drive real businesses — from trading automation to large-scale web platforms. I co-founded Mira Trading and Copile, and now work with Elevantiq on high-volume e-commerce infrastructure.

elevantiq.description: Architected order-processing systems at scale. Improved throughput by 45% through async queues, smarter caching, and optimized SQL. Platforms handle millions of transactions monthly.

mira.description: Developed a high-frequency Solana trading bot in Go. Automated token launches and real-time execution, reaching over 8,000 trades per month and generating $230K profit in five months.

copile.description: Built a B2B crypto trading platform used by 2,100+ clients. Designed a real-time API across five exchanges, processing roughly €1.2M in monthly volume.

ibm.description: Developed a Vue.js headless commerce storefront managing 85,000+ SKUs. Reduced promotion rollout time for enterprise clients by 40%.

connect.heading: Let's Connect
connect.description: I'm available for freelance projects and consulting. If you're building high-performance systems, blockchain integrations, or scalable web platforms — let's talk about what we can build together.
